# Instagram Post Scraper

The Apify actor [`apify/instagram-post-scraper`](https://apify.com/apify/instagram-post-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.646**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Scrape Instagram posts. Just add one or more Instagram usernames and get your data in seconds including caption, metrics, images, mentions, coauthors, recent comments, sponsored status, video duration, views. Export scraped data, schedule scraper via API, integrate with other tools or AI workflows.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Post $0.0017, Post details $0.001, Add-on: Music data $0.007 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/instagram-post-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-instagram-post-scraper@0.0.646#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      username: []
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `username` | array | yes |  | 🕺 Instagram username, profile URL, or post URL — Insert the username or URL of any profile you want to get posts from. You can also paste the post URLs. |
| `resultsLimit` | integer |  |  | 💯 Maximum posts per profile — This is the maximum number of posts you want to scrape per profile. If you set it to 5, you'll get 5 posts for each profile you've included. This setting does not apply if you're scraping by post URLs. |
| `skipPinnedPosts` | boolean |  | `false` | 📌 Skip pinned posts — Check if you do not want to save pinned posts. |
| `includeMusicData` | boolean |  | `false` | $ Include music data (for Images and Carousels) — Extract music data for Image and Carousel posts. Video posts already include music data with `Detailed data`. Available for paying users only. Upgrade to the Starter plan (https://console.apify.com/billing/subscription) to unlock it. |
| `onlyPostsNewerThan` | string |  |  | 📅 Extract posts that are newer than — Limit how far back to the history the scraper should go. The date should be in YYYY-MM-DD or full ISO absolute format or in relative format e.g. 1 days, 2 months, 3 years. All time values are taken in UTC timezone |
| `dataDetailLevel` | string |  | `"detailedData"` | Data detail level — Choose the data package you want to extract. Please note the Detailed data are paid extra. |

Each dataset item is typed from the actor's published dataset schema. Every field may be null, and items may carry fields beyond these.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string \| null | Unique identifier of the post |
